title: Desktop foundation: bwm module split without arch branches, deferred validation, display harvest, #2389 startup fix, compositor status and composite history, UI clock, and the shared desktop boot mode with its shared init-mode mapping

startup.why: first-client, existing-windows, independent-clients and supervisor-starts need #2389's receipt-free startup frame, client presentation on native fronts and the shared init desktop (both arches, ruling W1) that supervises bwm and bterm.

composition.why: client-update and expose-close need repaint on commit and on window removal with completed device receipts.

lifecycle.why: client-exit, client-crash and client-exec are kernel-handled removals that need only bwm repainting the survivor.

recovery.why: clients-notified needs the compositor epoch bwm publishes through /proc/breenix/compositor (lane 2A status page).

liveness.why: idle-no-composites and wake-on-registry need the UI clock (BGCLK001), epoch acknowledgment and no clock-driven composite; no input.
